name: physical_tolerance_diagnostic
declaration_scope: Declared before v12 full results. Classification uses TestBench exports and source units; thresholds were not fitted to v11 or v12 deltas.
document_gate: Existing exact serialized numeric comparison remains unchanged; this diagnostic never grants a document pass.

coverage_validation.actual_csv_header_match_verified: bullet-numeric-v7/smoke header only; no result values used

application_requirements: Diagnostic only. Keep the existing exact document bench gate and strict p50/p95 timing gates unchanged.
Require complete successful execution and validated metrics/log/events/timing evidence before discussing agreement.
Require this complete ordered header. Missing, duplicate, extra/unknown columns or changed source export precision fail until explicitly reclassified.
Compare every matched frame; every classified field must satisfy its rule. No p95, majority, inactive-column or near-singularity exemption.
Hero x,y,z form one Euclidean vector with delta strictly less than 0.1 cm. Do not accept equality at the boundary.
Other spatial scalars are bounded individually by 0.1 cm; this alone does not imply a 0.1 cm Euclidean bound on a three-component derived point.
Orientation rules use direct absolute serialized-degree differences; no modulo/wrapping exemption is introduced here.
Every integer, discrete, whole-number export, time value and text value remains exact.

Finite/nonfinite status and all semantic invalid-value sentinels must match exactly before applying any continuous tolerance. Missed-ray -inf heights are allowed only in both rows with the corresponding exact has/toehas=0 flag.
Use decimal arithmetic for serialized scalar boundaries, avoiding binary parsing residue. For hero distance compare squared decimal distance strictly against 0.01 cm^2.
Report exact equality separately, plus per-field diagnostic exceedance counts, maximum deltas, thresholds and first failing rows. Never relabel an exact-gate failure as a document pass.
outside_csv_exact_invariants: Event/shot ordering and counts, actor/target/victim identity, hit/miss/zone, damage, integer HP and dice outcomes remain exact.
Game/event/shot/damage/fight timestamps remain exact and present; missing timestamps cannot compare equal merely because both are absent.
Existing ordered-combat continuous-value gates remain required and are never replaced by these CSV physical tolerances.
E2E assertions/readiness and physics p50/p95 <= Bullet remain independently required.

text_exact.rationale: Keep segment identity, selected bone and playing animation layers.

integer_exact.rationale: All integer exports, flags, states, indices, counters and HP are exact.

time_ms_exact.rationale: Keep frame and game-time alignment; no time tolerance.

time_seconds_exact.rationale: Float-valued time measurements also remain exact.

hero_xyz.rationale: Every hero position vector must differ by strictly less than one millimetre, not merely each coordinate.

spatial.rationale: One millimetre per exported spatial scalar. This is a physical diagnostic bound, not a claim that larger-than-quantum differences are rounding alone.

orientation.rationale: One tenth of a degree for every orientation scalar, without percentile exceptions or automatic suppression near singular configurations.

normal_component.rationale: One thousandth per ray-normal component; all contact flags and missing-ray markers must still match exactly.

normalized.rationale: One thousandth for normalized weights, progress, stance amounts and probabilities; some are exported only to 0.01, so any one-digit change then still fails.

speed_cm_s.rationale: One quantum of the source %.1f speed export; the separate hero-position bound prevents accumulated displacement from being excused.

speed_degree_s.rationale: One quantum of Lean turn-rate %.1f export; this is angular speed, not an orientation angle.

screen_percent.rationale: One quantum of the %.3f screen-motion export. It cannot be converted to cm without camera/resolution assumptions.

dimensionless_exact.rationale: Archer disturbance is bounded by MaxDisturb=2, not a normalized weight. Keep it exact rather than infer a physical tolerance.

phase_exact.rationale: Bow nock phase crosses quiver/string phases; keep this mixed semantic progress exact.

whole_speed_exact.rationale: Continuous animation speed is serialized with %.0f; preserve all whole-number serialized values exactly.

whole_spatial_exact.rationale: NPC archer lead is serialized with %.0f; preserve whole-number serialized values exactly.

rationale: Physical bounds (1 mm spatial, 0.1 degree orientation, 0.001 normalized/component) differ deliberately from serialization resolution. They explain bounded continuous variation; they do not prove that differing numbers arose only from rounding.

Speed and angular-speed bounds use one %.1f source quantum, not a generic distance/angle threshold. Whole-number speed/lead exports remain exact. Time, screen-motion, disturbance and phase have distinct conservative rules.
At a 1 m lever arm, 0.1 degree corresponds to about 1.75 mm of transverse motion, so the angle rule is not interchangeable with the 1 mm spatial rule.

The user waiver for correct tiny-sphere normals concerns the separate sphere-query oracle. It does not authorize this physical diagnostic, relax its contact flags, or waive foot ray-normal differences.
A passing diagnostic means only bounded classified differences with all required discrete/gameplay invariants intact. The current document gate still requires exact serialized numerical equality.
